messages.text:
Built the production-quality TanStack Start marketplace and left the verified production preview running.

- App: http://127.0.0.1:3200
- Storefront, prompt detail, cart/checkout, and creator analytics use file routes under `src/routes`.
- SQLite persistence, seed data, ranked catalog queries, cart totals, checkout, revenue, conversion, AOV, category, and daily-sales calculations are implemented in `src/data/db.server.ts:1` and `src/data/queries.server.ts:1`.
- Validated TanStack Start server functions are in `src/server/marketplace.functions.ts:1`.
- The reusable marketplace UI and responsive shell are in `src/components/Storefront.tsx:1`, `src/components/PromptCard.tsx:1`, `src/components/AppShell.tsx:1`, and `src/styles.css:1`.
- The source-grounded 22-prompt, 4-creator seed catalog is in `src/data/seed.ts:1`; persistent data is created at `data/powerprompt.db`.
- Runtime and test scripts are defined in `package.json:5`.

Verification passed:

- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run build`
- `npm run test:db` — 3 passed
- `npm run test:api` — 3 passed
- `npm run test:e2e` — 6 passed across desktop and mobile
- Production probes returned HTTP 200 for `/`, `/prompts/207`, and `/analytics`
- Production preview PID: `15120`

Visual captures inspected:

- `test-results/visual.e2e.ts-capture-storefront-and-preview-desktop/storefront.png`
- `test-results/visual.e2e.ts-capture-storefront-and-preview-mobile/storefront.png`

The implementation meets the requested engineering standard: real Start routing/configuration, server-backed mutations, local persistence, database-side calculations, accessible interactions, responsive masonry media, and separate database/API/browser tests.
